prompt: Design a three-tier pricing card section (Free, Pro, Team). Highlight the Pro tier as the recommended option.
expected_output: Per SKILL.md § Aesthetic defaults (Colour, Shadows): two-role colour architecture ($surface neutral + one accent; no third hue competing). The highlighted Pro tier carries: a coloured border using $accent, a layered shadow (≥ 2 layers: ambient e.g. 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04) + direct e.g. 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)), and either a 'Most popular' badge OR a slight scale-up. Does NOT combine all four treatments (border + scale + badge + extra shadow + colour shift). Coloured border + badge is the canonical pair. Hover state increases contrast (lighter accent in dark mode, or darker accent in light mode), never decreases. Nested border-radius rule honoured: child corner radius ≤ parent (concentric). CTA copy is action-specific ('Start Pro trial', not 'Get started').
